claims.symptom: Machine stops in middle of cut and displays Machine Paused
claims.failure_mode: intermittent pause circuit, usually in the stop discs
claims.corrective_action: adjust the pause plunger activation pressure

claims.symptom: Touch Screen buttons are out of alignment
claims.corrective_action: complete touch screen calibration and save and exit

claims.symptom: Cutting Tool or Pen does not move down
claims.failure_mode: tool or layer is not mapped properly
claims.corrective_action: map the tool to the spindle or the layer to the tool

claims.symptom: Laser Fume Extractor has reduced vacuum or no vacuum
claims.annotation_note: The association is conveyed by the Problem/Troubleshooting layout rather than a standalone causal sentence.

claims.symptom: Laser cutting path is too wide
claims.failure_mode: brass laser nozzle is damaged or bent

claims.symptom: Loss of laser cutting power causing non-cut edges
claims.failure_mode: focusing lens is damaged or dirty
claims.corrective_action: clean or replace the focusing lens

claims.symptom: Loss of laser cutting power causing non-cut edges
claims.failure_mode: beam deflecting mirror is damaged or dirty

claims.symptom: Loss of laser cutting power causing non-cut edges
claims.failure_mode: laser nozzle contains damage or debris
claims.corrective_action: clean or replace the laser nozzle
